# AdFunnl

> AdFunnl is a marketing analytics and ad reporting platform for agencies, media buyers and performance marketers. It connects ad accounts on Meta, TikTok, Snapchat and Google with store revenue from Shopify, converts everything into one reporting currency, and shows it in one live dashboard that can be shared with clients as a view-only link or a PDF.

AdFunnl is a web app at https://app.adfunnl.com, operated by Funnl Suite LLC in Alexandria, Egypt. The app and this site are available in English and Arabic. There is a free plan, and paid plans are priced in USD and EGP.

## What it does

- Connect: Meta, TikTok, Snapchat and Google Ads, plus Shopify, Bosta and Google Sheets import. Coming next: Salla, Zid and Easy Orders stores, LinkedIn Ads, Google Analytics and HubSpot. Data syncs on a schedule set by the plan, from every 12 hours down to hourly.
- Visualize: a freeform drag-and-drop dashboard builder with KPI tiles, charts, tables, funnels, geo maps and creative galleries. Blended ROAS, spend, purchases and revenue across platforms, product-level ROAS from store data, and comparison against the prior period.
- Ready-made reports: Ads manager (every campaign from every ad platform in one table, down to the ad, with on and off switches and budgets for Meta and TikTok), Ads timeline (daily figures, blended and per platform, with the change log marked) and Audience insights (region, gender, age, device and placement, from Meta and Snapchat). Saved views keep dates, filters and formatting.
- Creative analysis: ads ranked by a composite score (Best Creatives) on Meta, TikTok and Snapchat, ad fatigue tracking on every ad platform, spend timeline per ad, and hook and hold video retention on Meta.
- Alerts: fund reminders for Meta ad account balances, and a sync log showing when each account last updated.
- Share: live view-only links, frozen report snapshots, PDF export, the client's logo on their dashboard, and video ads that play inside shared reports.
- Ask: an in-app AI assistant (Ada) that answers questions about the data in English or Arabic, reviews every ad set and ad of a brand, and can build a dashboard after you approve its plan, plus an MCP server so Claude, ChatGPT or any MCP client can query the same data.
- Ad control: from Claude or ChatGPT, change ads after approving each change in the chat. Pause, turn on and change budgets on Meta, TikTok, Snapchat and Google (Google: campaigns only). Duplicate, rename, delete and edit audiences, ad text and URL tags on Meta, TikTok and Snapchat. Launch new campaigns and add new ad sets and ads on Meta, TikTok, Snapchat and Google (Google: Search, Shopping, Display, Demand Gen and Performance Max, videos from YouTube; plus keywords and search terms). Catalog ads, lead forms, comment replies and A/B tests on the platforms that support them. Create audiences on Meta, TikTok and Snapchat, and website-visitor lists on Google. Anything new starts paused. Every change is written to the brand's Change Log, which the AI reads beside the numbers when it reviews an account, compares periods or lists campaigns. The same changes work from the assistant inside AdFunnl. A campaign created through AdFunnl on Meta, TikTok or Snapchat can be copied to the brand's other platforms with one approval. Included on every paid plan with the AI assistant and MCP access, and in the free trial.
- Why one MCP for every ad platform: one connection reaches Meta, TikTok, Snapchat and Google, and already knows which ad accounts belong to which brand, with each brand's notes, goal and targets, shared between the team, the in-app assistant and Claude or ChatGPT. Every change is in the brand's Change Log, shown on the Ads timeline beside the results and read by the AI. The MCP gets fixes every week, and support is answered by a person on WhatsApp or email.
- Connecting: Claude (Settings, Connectors, Add custom connector), ChatGPT (Settings, Plugins, Add custom MCP server, where the ChatGPT plan allows it), Claude Code (`claude mcp add`), or any assistant that supports remote MCP servers with OAuth sign-in. The MCP server address is https://api.adfunnl.com/mcp (remote MCP over streamable HTTP, OAuth sign-in with an AdFunnl account, no API key). No account is needed beforehand: the sign-in page the assistant opens has Create an account, and after signup the person returns to finish connecting, then connects their ad accounts in AdFunnl.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.adfunnl.com/): overview of the product
- [Pricing](https://www.adfunnl.com/pricing): Free, Solo, Growth and Agency plans
- [Pricing as plain text](https://www.adfunnl.com/pricing.md): plan prices and limits in markdown
- [Features](https://www.adfunnl.com/features): every feature the app ships today, one plain line each, with platform and plan limits
- [Dashboards](https://www.adfunnl.com/features/dashboard): the dashboard builder
- [Integrations](https://www.adfunnl.com/integrations): every ad platform, store and AI assistant AdFunnl connects to, what each brings in, and what is coming next
- [Meta ads reporting](https://www.adfunnl.com/integrations/meta): what comes in from Meta, breakdowns, creative ranking and changing Meta ads
- [Snapchat ads reporting](https://www.adfunnl.com/integrations/snapchat): what comes in from Snapchat, audience breakdowns, creative ranking and running Snapchat from Claude or ChatGPT
- [TikTok ads reporting](https://www.adfunnl.com/integrations/tiktok): what comes in from TikTok, creative ranking and switching TikTok campaigns
- [Contact](https://www.adfunnl.com/contact): WhatsApp and email
- [Affiliate program](https://www.adfunnl.com/affiliates): agencies and media buyers earn 10% of what each new customer they bring pays for 12 months, paid in EGP by bank transfer or InstaPay
- [AI ad control](https://www.adfunnl.com/ai-ad-control): make Claude or ChatGPT your assistant media buyer over AdFunnl's MCP server, why one MCP for every ad platform, how to connect each assistant, and what it can change on each platform
- [Connect Claude](https://www.adfunnl.com/ai-ad-control/claude): how to connect Claude and Claude Code to Meta, TikTok, Snapchat and Google ads through AdFunnl, in three steps, and what to ask first
- [For Account Managers](https://www.adfunnl.com/for/account-managers): client reporting
- [For Team Leads](https://www.adfunnl.com/for/team-leads): overseeing many accounts
- [For Media Buyers](https://www.adfunnl.com/for/media-buyers): daily analysis and creative ranking
- [About](https://www.adfunnl.com/about): who operates AdFunnl
- [Security](https://www.adfunnl.com/security): how workspace data is protected
- [Blog](https://www.adfunnl.com/blog): guides for media buyers and performance marketers

## Guides

- [How to launch one campaign on Meta, TikTok and Snapchat with one approval](https://www.adfunnl.com/blog/launch-one-campaign-on-meta-tiktok-and-snapchat): build a campaign once and copy it to the other platforms from Claude or ChatGPT, what changes per platform (age bands, budgets, ad formats, objectives), and what it does not copy
- [How to calculate blended ROAS across every ad platform](https://www.adfunnl.com/blog/how-to-calculate-blended-roas): the formula, why averaging platform ROAS or adding up platform revenue gives the wrong number, platform revenue against store revenue, a worked example in EGP, SAR and USD, and which exchange rate to use
